title: Jackie Gleason's UFO-shaped house
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Jackie Gleason's UFO-shaped house, about 20th century; for sale in 2025 at upstate New York, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But so, uh, he has his house built like a UFO. He has this circular house with windows all around it that like looks like a giant UFO made out of wood.

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, tells of a house built by the comedian Jackie Gleason in upstate New York, which he says was up for sale in 2025. According to Rogan, it is a circular wooden house with windows all around that looks like a giant UFO. He brings it up as a sign of how taken with UFOs Gleason was.
